author: Linh Ngo
recipient_verification: Verified Anthropic company page, linking anthropic.com, reposted this Claude announcement.
copy:
For third-party evaluators, what evidence would distinguish reliable responses to an explicit permission update from restraint during an agent’s own task rollout?

I’m developing MurderBench, starting with a deliberately narrow, fixed-history suite that includes Opus 5.5 through a pinned OpenRouter route. It records proposals only, with no action execution or general safety ranking. I’m seeking criticism of construct validity and overlap with existing evaluations before extending it: https://murderbench.com/program.html.

Is your published third-party evaluation initiative the appropriate route for a methodological-review or program-fit request at this stage? I’m not assuming the initiative is currently accepting proposals.
